description: Schema vectors of libre-ai.produit.v1. Each invalid vector is the first valid one with one change: `set` writes a value at a path, `unset` removes the key at a path. A path names one field of the fiche; an empty path is the fiche itself. `expect` is a fragment of the schema error. Every constraint of the schema has a vector here that becomes valid when the constraint is removed: ecosystem/produits.test.ts removes them one by one and fails on a constraint no vector holds. The rules that need another source (catalogue, inventory, other fiches, the count of etiquettes, the names of a_relire) are not schema rules: they are exercised in the same test file.
